227	class SwiGLU_MLP(nn.Module):
228	    """SwiGLU feed-forward block — the Llama MLP that Mamba-3 alternates with the
229	    mixer (Section 3.4: "the overall architecture follows Llama, alternating
230	    Mamba-3 and SwiGLU blocks with pre-norm").
231	
232	        SwiGLU(x) = down( SiLU(gate(x)) * up(x) )
233	
234	    Three Linear layers, NO biases (Llama convention; the paper does not mention
235	    MLP biases and follows Llama, which uses bias-free MLP projections). The
236	    inner ("hidden"/MLP) dimension is ``d_ff``; at the canonical 1.5B scale
237	    (d_model=2048) the paper's SISO MLP dim is **4096 = 2 * d_model** (Appendix C
238	    Table — "SISO MLP dim ... 1.5B: 4,096"; Appendix D fixes expand factor 2), so
239	    the default ``mlp_ratio=2`` reproduces 4096 at d=2048. (The MIMO variant
240	    shrinks this to 3824 to parameter-match; SISO uses the full 4096.)
241	
242	    Note: SwiGLU's gated structure means three projections of width ``d_ff`` cost
243	    the same as a plain MLP of inner width ``1.5 * d_ff`` (the classic Llama
244	    "2/3" trick is folded into the chosen 4096 here — the paper states 4096
245	    directly, so we use it directly and do NOT re-apply a 2/3 factor).
246	    """
247	
248	    def __init__(self, d: int, d_ff: Optional[int] = None, mlp_ratio: int = 2):
249	        super().__init__()
250	        self.d = d
251	        self.d_ff = d_ff if d_ff is not None else mlp_ratio * d
252	        # Llama-style bias-free projections.
253	        self.gate_proj = nn.Linear(d, self.d_ff, bias=False)   # W_gate
254	        self.up_proj = nn.Linear(d, self.d_ff, bias=False)     # W_up
255	        self.down_proj = nn.Linear(self.d_ff, d, bias=False)   # W_down
256	
257	    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
258	        """x: [B, L, d] -> [B, L, d]  (NO residual; caller adds it Llama-style)."""
259	        return self.down_proj(F.silu(self.gate_proj(x)) * self.up_proj(x))

262	class Mamba3Layer(nn.Module):
263	    """Base SISO Mamba-3 layer (complex-valued exponential-trapezoidal SSM).
264	
265	    Drop-in for Mamba-1 SelectiveSSMLayer: __init__(d, ...) / forward(x)->x.
266	    Real-valued I/O; complex state materialized as 2x2 rotation blocks on a real
267	    state of size ``state_dim`` (=2 * complex_dim). NO conv1d (see module
268	    docstring (0)).
269	
270	    Parameters
271	    ----------
272	    d : int                model dim D
273	    state_dim : int        REAL SSM state size N (default 128, must be EVEN;
274	                           complex dim = state_dim//2)
275	    dt_rank : int | None   low-rank dt projection rank (default max(d//16,1))
276	    expand_factor : int    inner expansion (default 2 -> d_inner = 2*d)
277	    head_dim : int         SSM head dim P (default 64); n_heads = d_inner//head_dim
278	    rmsnorm_eps : float    eps for BCNorm (default 1e-5)
279	    residual : bool        if True (default) the block adds its own input
280	                           residual (``out + x``) — the Mamba-1/-2 drop-in
281	                           contract. In the Llama-style ``Mamba3Model`` the
282	                           residual + pre-norm are done at the BLOCK level
283	                           (``h = h + Mixer(RMSNorm(h))``), so the mixer is
284	                           constructed with ``residual=False`` and returns the
285	                           bare ``out``. (Section 3.4 "follows Llama ...
286	                           with pre-norm".)
287	    """
288	
289	    def __init__(
290	        self,
291	        d: int,
292	        state_dim: int = 128,
293	        dt_rank: Optional[int] = None,
294	        expand_factor: int = 2,
295	        head_dim: int = 64,
296	        rmsnorm_eps: float = 1e-5,
297	        residual: bool = True,
298	    ):
299	        super().__init__()
300	        assert state_dim % 2 == 0, "state_dim must be even (complex dim = state_dim/2)"
301	        self.d = d
302	        self.state_dim = state_dim                 # N (real state size)
303	        self.complex_dim = state_dim // 2          # N_c
304	        self.expand_factor = expand_factor
305	        self.d_inner = d * expand_factor           # SISO channel count
306	        self.dt_rank = dt_rank or max(d // 16, 1)
307	        # head structure: n_heads channels of width head_dim. If d_inner is not a
308	        # multiple of head_dim (tiny-d grokking gate), fall back to head_dim=d_inner
309	        # (single head) so the toy config still runs. (See MAMBA3_REFERENCE.md.)
310	        if self.d_inner % head_dim != 0:
311	            head_dim = self.d_inner
312	        self.head_dim = head_dim
313	        self.n_heads = self.d_inner // head_dim
314	        self.rmsnorm_eps = rmsnorm_eps
315	        self.residual = residual
316	
317	        # --- input projection (no conv): x_main + gate z, like Mamba-1/-2 ------
318	        self.in_proj = nn.Linear(d, self.d_inner * 2, bias=False)
319	
320	        # --- SSM parameter projections from the main path (no SiLU) ------------
321	        # All SSM params are DATA-DEPENDENT (Remark 1). PER-HEAD vs head-shared
322	        # vs per-channel follows the paper (Sec 3.3 / App C — see module docstring
323	        # (3)):
324	        #   dt : low-rank (dt_rank) -> PER HEAD (n_heads) (Mamba-1 style low-rank)
325	        #   A_real (log-rate): PER HEAD (n_heads) data-dependent modulation
326	        #   theta (rotation freq, imaginary part): per complex_dim (shared across heads)
327	        #   lambda (trapezoidal gate u_t): PER HEAD (n_heads) -> sigmoid
328	        #   B, C : complex_dim each for real part + complex_dim each for imag part
329	        #          (Bhat, Chat) -> shared across heads (multi-value attention).
330	        # x_proj emits the concatenation, then we split.
331	        self.x_proj = nn.Linear(
332	            self.d_inner,
333	            self.dt_rank          # dt (low-rank)
334	            + self.n_heads        # A_real log-rate modulation (per head)
335	            + self.complex_dim    # theta (rotation freq)
336	            + self.n_heads        # lambda gate u_t (per head)
337	            + 2 * self.complex_dim  # B real + B imag (Bhat)
338	            + 2 * self.complex_dim,  # C real + C imag (Chat)
339	            bias=False,
340	        )
341	        # dt_proj maps the low-rank dt to PER-HEAD dt (n_heads), not per-channel.
342	        self.dt_proj = nn.Linear(self.dt_rank, self.n_heads, bias=True)
343	
344	        # Base A_log parameter — PER HEAD scalar real part (Mamba-2 style init
345	        # A=arange(1..n_heads)); A_t = -softplus(this base + data-dependent
346	        # per-head log-rate). The real part of A is a scalar per head (the
347	        # rotation R_t carries the per-coord structure), so this is [n_heads],
348	        # NOT a per-coord spectrum.
349	        A = torch.arange(1, self.n_heads + 1, dtype=torch.float32)
350	        self.A_log = nn.Parameter(torch.log(A).contiguous())   # [n_heads]
351	
352	        # per-channel D skip / feedthrough (Mamba-1/-2 retained, Fig.2 scaffold)
353	        self.D = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(self.d_inner))
354	
355	        # --- BCNorm (QKNorm): RMSNorm on B and C over the complex_dim ----------
356	        self.B_norm = RMSNorm(self.complex_dim, eps=rmsnorm_eps)   # on B real-part stream
357	        self.Bhat_norm = RMSNorm(self.complex_dim, eps=rmsnorm_eps)
358	        self.C_norm = RMSNorm(self.complex_dim, eps=rmsnorm_eps)
359	        self.Chat_norm = RMSNorm(self.complex_dim, eps=rmsnorm_eps)
360	
361	        # --- learnable, data-INDEPENDENT, channel-wise B,C biases (Appendix F) -
362	        # added AFTER BCNorm, init all-ones. Head-specific in the MIMO/multi-head
363	        # case; here B,C are head-shared so the bias is per complex_dim.
364	        self.B_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(self.complex_dim))
365	        self.Bhat_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(self.complex_dim))
366	        self.C_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(self.complex_dim))
367	        self.Chat_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(self.complex_dim))
368	
369	        # --- output projection -------------------------------------------------
370	        self.out_proj = nn.Linear(self.d_inner, d, bias=False)

372	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
373	    # The complex exponential-trapezoidal selective scan (Eq 25 + Eq 5-6).
374	    # All intermediates materialized explicitly for the CUDA transcription.
375	    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
376	    def _mamba3_scan(
377	        self,
378	        x: torch.Tensor,        # [B,L,d_inner]   SSM input (no SiLU)
379	        dt: torch.Tensor,       # [B,L,n_heads]   > 0   (post-softplus, per head)
380	        A_real: torch.Tensor,   # [B,L,n_heads]   < 0   (per-head real part)
381	        phi: torch.Tensor,      # [B,L,n_heads,complex_dim]  rotation angle = dt*theta
382	        lam: torch.Tensor,      # [B,L,n_heads]   in (0,1)  per-head trapezoidal gate
383	        Bbar: torch.Tensor,     # [B,L,complex_dim,2]   (B real, Bhat) per complex coord
384	        Cbar: torch.Tensor,     # [B,L,complex_dim,2]   (C real, -Chat) per complex coord
385	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
386	        """Returns y : [B,L,d_inner].
387	
388	        Per Eq (5)-(6),(25). State h is real, shape
389	        [B, n_heads, head_dim, complex_dim, 2] (a 2-vector per complex coord per
390	        (head, channel-within-head)). Within a head the head_dim channels SHARE
391	        alpha_t, R_t (rotation), beta_t, gamma_t and the head-shared Bbar_t; they
392	        differ ONLY through the per-channel SSM input x. B,C are shared across ALL
393	        heads (MVA). y_t = Cbar_t^T h_t per channel.
394	        """
395	        Bt, L, di = x.shape
396	        Nc = self.complex_dim
397	        H = self.n_heads
398	        P = self.head_dim
399	        device = x.device
400	
401	        # x reshaped to [B, n_heads, head_dim] per step (di = H*P).
402	        x_h = x.view(Bt, L, H, P)
403	
404	        # alpha_t = exp(dt * A_real)              [B,L,H]
405	        alpha = torch.exp(dt * A_real)
406	        # gamma_t = lambda * dt                   [B,L,H]
407	        gamma = lam * dt
408	        # beta_t  = (1 - lambda) * dt * alpha     [B,L,H]
409	        beta = (1.0 - lam) * dt * alpha
410	        # cos/sin of rotation angle phi          [B,L,H,Nc]
411	        cos = torch.cos(phi)
412	        sin = torch.sin(phi)
413	
414	        # state h_{t-1}: [B, H, P, Nc, 2]
415	        h = torch.zeros(Bt, H, P, Nc, 2, dtype=x.dtype, device=device)
416	        # previous state-input term Bbar_{t-1} * x_{t-1}, used by the beta term.
417	        # v_t := Bbar_t * x_t  has shape [B, H, P, Nc, 2] (Bbar shared over H,P).
418	        v_prev = torch.zeros(Bt, H, P, Nc, 2, dtype=x.dtype, device=device)
419	
420	        ys = []
421	        for t in range(L):
422	            x_t = x_h[:, t, :, :].view(Bt, H, P, 1, 1)           # [B,H,P,1,1]
423	            Bbar_t = Bbar[:, t, :, :].view(Bt, 1, 1, Nc, 2)      # [B,1,1,Nc,2] (shared H,P)
424	            Cbar_t = Cbar[:, t, :, :].view(Bt, 1, 1, Nc, 2)      # [B,1,1,Nc,2]
425	            v_t = Bbar_t * x_t                                   # [B,H,P,Nc,2] state-input
426	            cos_t = cos[:, t, :, :].view(Bt, H, 1, Nc)           # [B,H,1,Nc] (shared over P)
427	            sin_t = sin[:, t, :, :].view(Bt, H, 1, Nc)
428	            alpha_t = alpha[:, t, :].view(Bt, H, 1, 1, 1)        # [B,H,1,1,1]
429	            beta_t = beta[:, t, :].view(Bt, H, 1, 1, 1)
430	            gamma_t = gamma[:, t, :].view(Bt, H, 1, 1, 1)
431	
432	            # R_t @ h_{t-1}  and  R_t @ v_{t-1}   (block-diag 2x2 rotation per coord)
433	            Rh = apply_rotation(h, cos_t, sin_t)                 # [B,H,P,Nc,2]
434	            Rv_prev = apply_rotation(v_prev, cos_t, sin_t)       # [B,H,P,Nc,2]
435	
436	            # Eq (25): h_t = alpha*R h_{t-1} + beta*R (Bbar_{t-1} x_{t-1}) + gamma*(Bbar_t x_t)
437	            h = alpha_t * Rh + beta_t * Rv_prev + gamma_t * v_t  # [B,H,P,Nc,2]
438	
439	            # y_t = Cbar_t^T h_t  =  sum over complex coords of (Cr*hr + Ci*hi)
440	            #   (real part of complex inner product; Cbar already = [C, -Chat])
441	            y_t = (Cbar_t * h).sum(dim=(3, 4)).reshape(Bt, di)   # [B,d_inner]
442	            ys.append(y_t)
443	
444	            v_prev = v_t  # carry for next step's beta term
445	
446	        return torch.stack(ys, dim=1)                            # [B,L,d_inner]
447	
448	    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
449	        """x: [B, L, d] -> [B, L, d].
450	
451	        If ``self.residual`` is True the input residual ``out + x`` is added
452	        here (Mamba-1/-2 drop-in). If False (the Llama-style ``Mamba3Model``
453	        path) the bare ``out`` is returned and the caller adds the residual
454	        around the pre-norm.
455	        """
456	        residual = x
457	        B_, L, _ = x.shape
458	
459	        # input projection + split into main path & gate
460	        xz = self.in_proj(x)                                     # [B,L,2*d_inner]
461	        x_main, z = xz.chunk(2, dim=-1)                          # each [B,L,d_inner]
462	
463	        # NO conv1d and NO SiLU on the SSM input: the paper (Sec 3.4, line 678)
464	        # obviates the short conv "AND its accompanying activation function", so
465	        # x_main feeds the projections and the scan directly. (RESOLVED.)
466	        x_in = x_main                                            # [B,L,d_inner]
467	
468	        # SSM parameter projections (all data-dependent)
469	        proj = self.x_proj(x_in)
470	        dt_lr, A_mod, theta, u_lam, Br, Bi, Cr, Ci = torch.split(
471	            proj,
472	            [
473	                self.dt_rank,
474	                self.n_heads,        # A_real log-rate modulation (per head)
475	                self.complex_dim,    # theta (rotation freq, head-shared)
476	                self.n_heads,        # lambda gate u_t (per head)
477	                self.complex_dim,    # B real
478	                self.complex_dim,    # B imag (Bhat)
479	                self.complex_dim,    # C real
480	                self.complex_dim,    # C imag (Chat)
481	            ],
482	            dim=-1,
483	        )
484	
485	        # dt = softplus(dt_proj(dt_lr))  > 0     [B,L,n_heads]  (PER HEAD)
486	        dt = F.softplus(self.dt_proj(dt_lr))
487	
488	        # A_real < 0 : per-head scalar base rate (exp(A_log), [n_heads]) made
489	        # data-dependent by A_mod (per head), then negated through softplus so
490	        # alpha=exp(dt*A_real) in (0,1]. A_real shape [B,L,n_heads]. The real part
491	        # of A is a SCALAR per head (Eq 9/17, line ~1431); the rotation R_t (built
492	        # from theta) carries the per-coordinate structure.
493	        base_rate = torch.exp(self.A_log)                        # [n_heads]
494	        A_real = -F.softplus(A_mod + base_rate.view(1, 1, -1))   # [B,L,n_heads] < 0
495	
496	        # theta -> rotation angle phi = dt * theta. dt is PER HEAD [B,L,H], theta
497	        # is head-shared [B,L,Nc]; the exact per-head angle is their outer product
498	        # phi[b,l,h,c] = dt[b,l,h] * theta[b,l,c]  ->  [B,L,H,Nc]. No mean approx.
499	        phi = dt.unsqueeze(-1) * theta.unsqueeze(-2)             # [B,L,H,Nc]
500	
501	        # lambda_t = sigmoid(u_t)  in (0,1)      [B,L,n_heads]  (Appendix A.3 default)
502	        lam = torch.sigmoid(u_lam)
503	
504	        # BCNorm (RMSNorm) then add channel-wise all-ones-init biases (Appendix F):
505	        Br = self.B_norm(Br) + self.B_bias                       # [B,L,complex_dim]
506	        Bi = self.Bhat_norm(Bi) + self.Bhat_bias
507	        Cr = self.C_norm(Cr) + self.C_bias
508	        Ci = self.Chat_norm(Ci) + self.Chat_bias
509	
510	        # Build Bbar = [B ; Bhat], Cbar = [C ; -Chat] per complex coord (Prop 2).
511	        Bbar = torch.stack((Br, Bi), dim=-1)                     # [B,L,complex_dim,2]
512	        Cbar = torch.stack((Cr, -Ci), dim=-1)                    # [B,L,complex_dim,2]
513	
514	        # the complex exponential-trapezoidal scan (Eq 25)
515	        y = self._mamba3_scan(x_in, dt, A_real, phi, lam, Bbar, Cbar)  # [B,L,d_inner]
516	
517	        # D skip + gated output (phi(Y,Z) = Y (.) SiLU(Z), Appendix C, Eq C)
518	        y = y + x_in * self.D.view(1, 1, -1)
519	        y = y * F.silu(z)
520	
521	        # output projection + (optional) block residual
522	        out = self.out_proj(y)                                   # [B,L,d]
523	        if self.residual:
524	            return out + residual
525	        return out

528	class Mamba3Block(nn.Module):
529	    """One Llama-style layer of the Mamba-3 architecture: a Mamba-3 **mixer**
530	    sub-block followed by a **SwiGLU MLP** sub-block, each wrapped in pre-norm +
531	    residual (Section 3.4: "the overall architecture follows Llama, alternating
532	    Mamba-3 and SwiGLU blocks with pre-norm"):
533	
534	        h = h + Mamba3Mixer( RMSNorm_mix(h) )
535	        h = h + SwiGLU_MLP ( RMSNorm_mlp(h) )
536	
537	    The mixer is the existing ``Mamba3Layer`` constructed with ``residual=False``
538	    (its own internal residual is OFF; the residual is added here around the
539	    pre-norm, the Llama convention). This is the faithful Mamba-3 block: the
540	    mixer keeps its full internal scaffold (in_proj/scan/gate/out_proj, no conv,
541	    no SSM-input SiLU — Section 3.4) and the SwiGLU MLP is the new addition that
542	    the mixer-only reference was missing.
543	    """

545	    def __init__(
546	        self,
547	        d: int,
548	        state_dim: int = 128,
549	        dt_rank: Optional[int] = None,
550	        expand_factor: int = 2,
551	        head_dim: int = 64,
552	        d_ff: Optional[int] = None,
553	        mlp_ratio: int = 2,
554	        rmsnorm_eps: float = 1e-5,
555	    ):
556	        super().__init__()
557	        self.mixer_norm = RMSNorm(d, eps=rmsnorm_eps)
558	        self.mixer = Mamba3Layer(
559	            d,
560	            state_dim=state_dim,
561	            dt_rank=dt_rank,
562	            expand_factor=expand_factor,
563	            head_dim=head_dim,
564	            rmsnorm_eps=rmsnorm_eps,
565	            residual=False,                       # residual added at block level
566	        )
567	        self.mlp_norm = RMSNorm(d, eps=rmsnorm_eps)
568	        self.mlp = SwiGLU_MLP(d, d_ff=d_ff, mlp_ratio=mlp_ratio)

570	    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
571	        h = x + self.mixer(self.mixer_norm(x))    # pre-norm Mamba-3 mixer + residual
572	        h = h + self.mlp(self.mlp_norm(h))        # pre-norm SwiGLU MLP + residual

579	    sub-block, pre-norm + residual) -> final RMSNorm -> linear head on the LAST
580	    token. This is the COMPLETE Mamba-3 architecture of Section 3.4 ("alternating
581	    Mamba-3 and SwiGLU blocks with pre-norm"); the previous reference was
582	    mixer-only and is now superseded by this faithful Llama-style stack.
583	
584	    ALTERNATION CONVENTION (RESOLVED — see MAMBA3_REFERENCE.md §1.6): ``nl`` is
585	    the number of Mamba-3 **mixer** blocks, and EACH is paired with a SwiGLU MLP,
586	    so there are ``nl`` mixers + ``nl`` SwiGLU MLPs ("24 of each" at the 1.5B

588	    "procedures follow Dao and Gu 2024"), and is the convention that makes the
589	    canonical config (d_model=2048, nl=24, MLP inner 4096, Llama-3.1 vocab,

591	
592	    The post-gate RMSNorm of Mamba-2 is removed (BCNorm stabilizes, Section 3.4);

598	    config-parametrized.

602	        self,
603	        p: int = 97,
604	        ntok: int = 99,
605	        seq_len: int = 8,
606	        d: int = 128,
607	        nl: int = 2,
608	        state_dim: int = 128,
609	        expand_factor: int = 2,
610	        dt_rank: Optional[int] = None,
611	        head_dim: int = 64,
612	        d_ff: Optional[int] = None,
613	        mlp_ratio: int = 2,

616	        self.tok = nn.Embedding(ntok, d)
617	        self.pos = nn.Embedding(seq_len, d)
618	        self.layers = nn.ModuleList([
619	            Mamba3Block(
620	                d,
621	                state_dim=state_dim,
622	                dt_rank=dt_rank,
623	                expand_factor=expand_factor,
624	                head_dim=head_dim,
625	                d_ff=d_ff,
626	                mlp_ratio=mlp_ratio,
627	            )
628	            for _ in range(nl)
629	        ])
630	        self.norm = RMSNorm(d)
631	        self.out = nn.Linear(d, p)
632	        self.register_buffer("pos_ids", torch.arange(seq_len).unsqueeze(0))
633	
634	    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
635	        h = self.tok(x) + self.pos(self.pos_ids)
636	        for layer in self.layers:
637	            h = layer(h)
638	        return self.out(self.norm(h)[:, -1, :])

3	This is a **Python-level orchestration layer** that sits on top of the existing
4	optimizers and the Stage-6 fused megakernel. It introduces **no kernel changes**

12	  short-sequence (arithmetic grokking, small ViT/Mamba), so a sequence split

188	def _bucketize(tensors, bucket_elems: int):
189	    """Group ``tensors`` into contiguous buckets of ~``bucket_elems`` elements.
190	
191	    A single tensor larger than the target still forms its own (oversized)
192	    bucket so nothing is dropped. Order is preserved so the flat-buffer
193	    scatter-back in :meth:`DistributedContext.all_reduce_dp_grads` stays
194	    aligned. Pure-Python list math (no collectives) — unit-testable offline.
195	    """
196	    bucket: list = []
197	    cur = 0
198	    for t in tensors:
199	        n = t.numel()
200	        if bucket and cur + n > bucket_elems:
201	            yield bucket
202	            bucket, cur = [], 0
203	        bucket.append(t)
204	        cur += n
205	    if bucket:
206	        yield bucket

213	class _RankMesh:
214	    """The (dp, tp, pp) coordinates of this rank plus the per-dim peer ranks.
215	
216	    Rank-linearization order is the Megatron-LM convention: the fastest-varying
217	    dim is TP, then PP, then DP (``rank = ((dp * pp_size + pp) * tp_size + tp)``).
218	    Keeping TP contiguous puts the high-traffic tensor-parallel all-reduces on
219	    the tightest fabric (intra-node NVLink/Infinity-Fabric), which is what §8.6
220	    wants for maximal efficiency.
221	    """
222	
223	    global_rank: int
224	    world_size: int
225	    dp: int
226	    tp: int
227	    pp: int
228	    ep: int
229	    dp_ranks: Tuple[int, ...]
230	    tp_ranks: Tuple[int, ...]
231	    pp_ranks: Tuple[int, ...]
232	    ep_ranks: Tuple[int, ...]

234	
235	def _coords_from_rank(rank: int, dp: int, tp: int, pp: int) -> Tuple[int, int, int]:
236	    """Decompose a global rank into (dp, tp, pp) coords (TP fastest, then PP)."""
237	    tp_i = rank % tp
238	    pp_i = (rank // tp) % pp
239	    dp_i = rank // (tp * pp)
240	    return dp_i, tp_i, pp_i
241	
242	
243	def _rank_from_coords(dp_i: int, tp_i: int, pp_i: int, dp: int, tp: int, pp: int) -> int:
244	    return (dp_i * pp + pp_i) * tp + tp_i

247	def _build_mesh(rank: int, cfg: ParallelConfig) -> _RankMesh:
248	    """Pure-Python rank-mesh math (no collectives) — testable without a launch.
249	
250	    Computes this rank's (dp,tp,pp) coords and the peer-rank lists for each of
251	    the three subgroups it belongs to. The actual ``new_group`` calls happen in
252	    :meth:`DistributedContext._init_groups`; this keeps the index arithmetic
253	    unit-testable on a single process.
254	    """
255	    dp, tp, pp = cfg.data_parallel, cfg.tensor_parallel, cfg.pipeline_parallel
256	    ep = cfg.expert_parallel
257	    dp_i, tp_i, pp_i = _coords_from_rank(rank, dp, tp, pp)
258	
259	    # DP peers: vary dp_i, hold (tp_i, pp_i) — this is the ZeRO-3 shard group.
260	    dp_ranks = tuple(
261	        _rank_from_coords(d, tp_i, pp_i, dp, tp, pp) for d in range(dp)
262	    )
263	    # TP peers: vary tp_i, hold (dp_i, pp_i) — the per-layer all-reduce group.
264	    tp_ranks = tuple(
265	        _rank_from_coords(dp_i, t, pp_i, dp, tp, pp) for t in range(tp)
266	    )
267	    # PP peers: vary pp_i, hold (dp_i, tp_i) — the pipeline-stage send/recv group.
268	    pp_ranks = tuple(
269	        _rank_from_coords(dp_i, tp_i, p, dp, tp, pp) for p in range(pp)
270	    )
271	    # EP peers: the ``ep`` consecutive DP ranks that together hold one full
272	    # (sharded) expert set. DP is partitioned into dp/ep expert-replica blocks;
273	    # this rank's EP group is the block its dp_i falls in. EP coordinate is the
274	    # offset within that block. EP size 1 ⇒ a singleton group (no-op).
275	    ep_block_start = (dp_i // ep) * ep
276	    ep_dp_coords = range(ep_block_start, ep_block_start + ep)
277	    ep_ranks = tuple(
278	        _rank_from_coords(d, tp_i, pp_i, dp, tp, pp) for d in ep_dp_coords
279	    )
280	    ep_i = dp_i % ep
281	    return _RankMesh(
282	        global_rank=rank,
283	        world_size=cfg.world_size,
284	        dp=dp_i,
285	        tp=tp_i,
286	        pp=pp_i,
287	        ep=ep_i,
288	        dp_ranks=dp_ranks,
289	        tp_ranks=tp_ranks,
290	        pp_ranks=pp_ranks,
291	        ep_ranks=ep_ranks,
292	    )

296	    """Lazily-initialized holder of the DP/TP/PP process groups (§8.1).
297	
298	    Construction never touches ``torch.distributed``. Call :meth:`initialize`
299	    (or use :meth:`from_config`, which initializes) inside a launched job to
300	    build the subgroups. With no launched job everything degrades to a
301	    single-process world: ``world_size == 1``, ``rank == 0``, every parallel dim
302	    collapses to size 1, and every collective helper becomes a no-op. That is
303	    exactly the self-test / plain-import path, and it must not crash.
304	    """
305	
306	    def __init__(self, config: Optional[ParallelConfig] = None) -> None:
307	        self.config = config or ParallelConfig(use_megakernel=False)
308	        self._initialized = False
309	        self._mesh: Optional[_RankMesh] = None
310	        # Per-dim process-group handles (opaque; None ⇒ WORLD / single-process).
311	        self._dp_group = None
312	        self._tp_group = None
313	        self._pp_group = None

323	        """Build a context and initialize its groups if a job is launched.
324

326	        """
327	        ctx = cls(config)
328	        ctx.initialize()
329	        return ctx

331	    def initialize(self, init_method: Optional[str] = None) -> "DistributedContext":
332	        """Initialize process groups *if and only if* a job is launched.
333	
334	        Idempotent. With no launch (or torch.distributed unavailable) this marks
335	        the context single-process and returns immediately — no collective is
336	        ever issued, so import/self-test paths are safe.
337	        """
338	        if self._initialized:
339	            return self
340	        dist = _dist()
341	
342	        # Single-process / not-launched path: build a degenerate 1-rank mesh.
343	        if dist is None or not dist.is_available():
344	            self._mesh = _build_mesh(0, ParallelConfig())
345	            self._initialized = True
346	            return self

348	        # If the launcher set the env vars but the user has not yet called
349	        # init_process_group, initialize it lazily here (idempotent guard).
350	        if not dist.is_initialized():
351	            world_size = _env_int("WORLD_SIZE", 1)
352	            if world_size <= 1:
353	                # No real job — single process. Do NOT init a group.
354	                self._mesh = _build_mesh(0, ParallelConfig())
355	                self._initialized = True
356	                return self
357	            rank = _env_int("RANK", 0)
358	            backend = self.config.resolved_backend()
359	            try:
360	                dist.init_process_group(
361	                    backend=backend, init_method=init_method,
362	                    world_size=world_size, rank=rank,
363	                )
364	            except Exception:

366	                # import-time path. Fall back to single-process.
367	                self._mesh = _build_mesh(0, ParallelConfig())
368	                self._initialized = True
369	                return self

371	        rank = dist.get_rank()
372	        world_size = dist.get_world_size()
373	        self.config.validate_against_world(world_size)
374	        self._mesh = _build_mesh(rank, self.config)
375	        self._init_groups()
376	        self._initialized = True
377	        return self

379	    def _init_groups(self) -> None:
380	        """Create the DP/TP/PP subgroups via ``new_group`` (launched-job only).
381	
382	        ``new_group`` is a **collective** that every rank must enter for every
383	        group, so we iterate the full set of subgroups deterministically and
384	        each rank keeps the handle for the group it belongs to. This is the
385	        standard Megatron-LM group-construction pattern.
386	        """
387	        dist = _dist()
388	        assert dist is not None and self._mesh is not None
389	        cfg = self.config
390	        dp, tp, pp = cfg.data_parallel, cfg.tensor_parallel, cfg.pipeline_parallel
391	        ep = cfg.expert_parallel
392	        mesh = self._mesh
393	
394	        # Build every DP group (one per (tp_i, pp_i) slice).
395	        for tp_i in range(tp):
396	            for pp_i in range(pp):
397	                ranks = [
398	                    _rank_from_coords(d, tp_i, pp_i, dp, tp, pp) for d in range(dp)
399	                ]
400	                g = dist.new_group(ranks)
401	                if mesh.global_rank in ranks:
402	                    self._dp_group = g
403	        # Build every EP group (one per (tp_i, pp_i, dp-block) slice): the ``ep``
404	        # consecutive DP ranks that hold one full expert set. Only meaningful
405	        # when ep > 1; with ep == 1 each group is a singleton (still entered by
406	        # every rank — new_group is collective). Skipped entirely for ep == 1 to
407	        # avoid issuing dp*tp*pp singleton-group collectives.
408	        if ep > 1:
409	            for tp_i in range(tp):
410	                for pp_i in range(pp):
411	                    for block_start in range(0, dp, ep):
412	                        ranks = [
413	                            _rank_from_coords(d, tp_i, pp_i, dp, tp, pp)
414	                            for d in range(block_start, block_start + ep)
415	                        ]
416	                        g = dist.new_group(ranks)
417	                        if mesh.global_rank in ranks:
418	                            self._ep_group = g
419	        # Build every TP group (one per (dp_i, pp_i) slice).
420	        for dp_i in range(dp):
421	            for pp_i in range(pp):
422	                ranks = [
423	                    _rank_from_coords(dp_i, t, pp_i, dp, tp, pp) for t in range(tp)
424	                ]
425	                g = dist.new_group(ranks)
426	                if mesh.global_rank in ranks:
427	                    self._tp_group = g
428	        # Build every PP group (one per (dp_i, tp_i) slice).
429	        for dp_i in range(dp):
430	            for tp_i in range(tp):
431	                ranks = [
432	                    _rank_from_coords(dp_i, tp_i, p, dp, tp, pp) for p in range(pp)
433	                ]
434	                g = dist.new_group(ranks)
435	                if mesh.global_rank in ranks:
436	                    self._pp_group = g
437

439	        if is_dist_available_and_initialized():
440	            _dist().barrier()

443	        """Tear down the default group (best-effort; safe if never launched)."""

## 9. mamba3_block.py — Mamba-3 (SISO) reference (autograd-only PyTorch)

The reversible-foundation reference for the NEW `mamba` cell — a clean autograd module a CUDA
megakernel will be transcribed from line-for-line (`mamba3_block.py:7-12`). Imports torch only,
NO GPU / no compiled ext (@178-180). Implements base SISO Mamba-3 ONLY; complex state is
materialized as explicit real/imag 2×2 rotation blocks (NOT torch.complex) for autograd + kernel
portability (@16-19).

- `RMSNorm` (@197-209): computes in INPUT dtype (no fp32 downcast) — deliberately, so the fp64
  oracle stays exact (an internal .float() would cap at ~1e-7 and break the 1e-12
  manual-vs-autograd gate, @204-208).
- `apply_rotation(h_pair, cos, sin)` (@212-224): block-diag R(phi) per complex coord:
  (c*hr - s*hi, s*hr + c*hi).
- `SwiGLU_MLP` (@227-259): Llama bias-free gate/up/down; default mlp_ratio=2 → d_ff=4096 at
  d=2048; NO residual (caller adds it).
- `Mamba3Layer` (@262-525): base SISO mixer.
  - state_dim even (complex_dim=state_dim//2), d_inner=expand*d, dt_rank=max(d//16,1) default,
    head_dim=64 default; if d_inner%head_dim!=0 → single head (tiny-d grokking fallback @310-311).
  - NO conv1d (exponential-trapezoidal recurrence induces an implicit width-2 conv, Sec 3.1.2,
    @44-48) and NO SiLU on the SSM input (@463-465).
  - Projections: `in_proj` d→2*d_inner; `x_proj` d_inner→(dt_rank + n_heads + complex_dim +
    n_heads + 4*complex_dim) (@331-340); `dt_proj` dt_rank→n_heads (PER HEAD, @342); `A_log`
    [n_heads] (@349-350); per-channel `D` [d_inner] (@353); 4× BCNorm RMSNorm over complex_dim
    (@356-359); 4× all-ones B/C biases [complex_dim] (@364-367); `out_proj` d_inner→d (@370).
  - `_mamba3_scan` (@376-446): the SEQUENTIAL Eq-25 recurrence. State h [B,H,P,Nc,2]; per step:
    alpha=exp(dt*A_real), gamma=lam*dt, beta=(1-lam)*dt*alpha; v_t=Bbar_t*x_t;
    h = alpha*R@h_{t-1} + beta*R@v_{t-1} + gamma*v_t; y_t = (Cbar_t·h).sum. Carries v_prev.
    PER-HEAD: dt/A_real/lam per head; theta/B/C head-shared; x/D/z per channel. phi=dt⊗theta
    [B,L,H,Nc] (exact outer product, NOT a per-channel-mean approx, @496-499,138-150).
  - `forward` (@448-525): in_proj→chunk(x_main,z); x_proj→split 8 ways; dt=softplus(dt_proj);
    A_real=-softplus(A_mod+exp(A_log)) <0; phi=dt⊗theta; lam=sigmoid(u); BCNorm+bias on Br/Bi/Cr/
    Ci; Bbar=[Br,Bi], Cbar=[Cr,-Ci]; scan; y += x_in*D; y *= SiLU(z); out=out_proj(y) (+residual
    if self.residual). In Mamba3Block the mixer is residual=False.
- `Mamba3Block` (@528-573): Llama layer — `h = h + mixer(RMSNorm(h))`; `h = h + mlp(RMSNorm(h))`.
- `Mamba3Model` (@576-638): tok+pos embeddings → nl Mamba3Blocks → final RMSNorm → linear head on
  the LAST token (@634-638). nl counts MIXER blocks, each paired with a SwiGLU MLP ("24 of each"
  at 1.5B; previous mixer-only stack was 0.661B, this lands ~1.5B, @584-590).
